name: Prefix-$k$ Littlestone Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: For k=2, the recorded depth-three Littlestone witness has a common coordinate at its second level and is a prefix-2 tree. For k at least three, depth three would be level-constant on its first three levels and would shatter three coordinates, contradicting VC dimension two. The VC witness gives depth two.
references: Directly from the prefix-tree definition and the $C_5$ calculations in \cite{littlestone1988learning,palvolgyi2021unlabeled}.
